alate: Alate head deep brownish yellow, antennae pale yellow, compound eyes blackish brown, ocelli, antennal spots and maxillary palps yellowish brown, pronotum yellowish brown, wing veins deep brownish yellow, the wing membrane scattered with brownish yellow spots, legs pale yellowish brown. Head subcircular; compound eyes elongate-oval, their short diameter slightly greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head; ocelli nearly round-triangular, close to the compound eyes but not touching them; antennal spots nearly circular, larger than the ocelli. Antennae with eight segments, the third shortest, gradually increasing towards the tip, the anterior arm of the Y-shaped suture faintly visible. Pronotum narrower than the width of the head including the compound eyes, flat and square, the middle of the anterior margin slightly concave, the lateral margins slightly oblique backwards, the posterior margin nearly straight with a shallow median concavity, the posterolateral angles broadly rounded, the median longitudinal line visible, the wing surface covered with small warts.
